title: Syncope (transient loss of consciousness)
priority: Common ED presentation with its own US and European guidelines.

layer0.label: The event
layer0.detail: Prodrome, position (standing, sitting, supine), exertion, palpitations, triggers such as pain, cough, micturition or prolonged standing.

layer0.label: History
layer0.detail: Structural heart disease or prior myocardial infarction, family history of sudden cardiac death at a young age.

layer0.label: Exam
layer0.detail: Physical examination including lying and standing blood pressure.

layer0.label: 12-lead ECG
layer0.detail: Useful in the initial evaluation (class I).

gate.label: Any high-risk feature
gate.detail: New chest discomfort, breathlessness, abdominal pain or headache; syncope during exertion or supine; palpitations right before syncope; structural heart disease. Evaluate in hospital or with ECG monitoring.

gate.label: Low-risk features only
gate.detail: Typical reflex prodrome or trigger, or syncope on standing up. Likely reflex or orthostatic; discharge can be considered.

gate_note: Not all high-risk patients need admission; risk scores may be reasonable but are not better than clinical judgment.

hypotheses.name: Cardiac (arrhythmic or structural) syncope
hypotheses.clue: Exertional or supine, palpitations, heart disease

hypotheses.name: Serious condition presenting as syncope
hypotheses.clue: New chest pain, breathlessness, abdominal pain or headache

steps.title: Event history
steps.description: Separates low-risk reflex patterns from high-risk features.

card.text: Exertion, supine position, sudden palpitations, or no or very short prodrome with heart disease.

serious.text: New chest discomfort, breathlessness, abdominal pain or headache is a major high-risk feature.

orth.text: Syncope on standing up from lying or sitting.

reflex.text: Prodrome of light-headedness, warmth, sweating or nausea; pain, crowded hot places, cough or micturition triggers.

steps.title: Exam with lying and standing blood pressure
steps.description: Part of the standard initial evaluation.

orth.text: Lying and standing BP is the bedside test for orthostatic causes.

card.text: Findings of structural heart disease are high risk.

steps.title: 12-lead ECG
steps.description: Class I in the initial evaluation.

card.text: An abnormal ECG turns minor features into high-risk ones.

steps.title: Risk stratification and disposition
steps.description: Sorts patients into high, intermediate and low risk.

card.text: Low-risk features only: discharge from the ED is recommended for patients without recurrence.

reflex.text: Low-risk patients mostly have reflex syncope with a good prognosis.

steps.title: Targeted tests only when suspected
steps.description: Routine labs, cardiac imaging and carotid imaging are not useful without a specific reason.

card.text: ECG monitoring in high-risk patients with suspected arrhythmia; cardiac imaging only if a cardiac cause is suspected.

reflex.text: Tilt testing when reflex syncope is suspected.

orth.text: Tilt testing when an orthostatic cause is suspected.

eliminate_when.text: Only low-risk features after history, exam and ECG: ESC 2018 recommends discharge from the ED (class I, level B). Treating this disposition as elimination is the inferred part.

do_not_rely.text: Routine cardiac imaging without a suspected cardiac cause.
Risk scores as better than clinical judgment.

serious.no_rule_note: Route depends on the underlying condition (for example PE or dissection); see the chest pain situation.

do_not_rely.text: Carotid imaging without focal neurologic findings.

orth.no_rule_note: No elimination threshold extracted; orthostatic criteria are in the ESC guideline.

reflex.no_rule_note: Diagnosis is clinical; tilt testing when suspected.

gaps.title: Two guidelines
gaps.text: US (2017) and European (2018) guidelines overlap but differ in detail.

gaps.title: Intermediate risk
gaps.text: Patients with neither high- nor low-risk features have no single sourced pathway here.

gaps.title: Orthostatic thresholds
gaps.text: Exact blood pressure criteria were not extracted in this pass.
